description: FULL PLANNING APPLICATION FOR THE PROPOSED INSTALLATION OF SIXTEEN RAPID ELECTRIC VEHICLE CHARGING STATIONS AND ANCILLARY EQUIPMENT WITHIN THE CHAPTER WAY CAR PARK, INCLUDING FOUR FULLY ACCESSIBLE EV CHARGING BAYS.
decision_conditions:
<p style="text-align: justify; "><span style="line-height: 107%;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Construction Vehicles</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;"> - The development shall not commence until details
of the provision to accommodate all site workers', visitors' and construction
vehicles and loading /unloading arrangements during the construction process
have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning
Authority.&nbsp; The approved details must be
implemented and complied with for the duration of the construction process.</span></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;"><span style="line-height: 107%;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Reason</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;">: To ensure the safety of pedestrians and vehicles
and the amenities of the surrounding area and to comply with the following
Development Plan policies for Merton: policies T4 and T7 of the London Plan
2021 and policies T16.3 and T16.4 of the Local Plan 2024.</span></span><o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal">No development shall commence until a Heritage Statement has
been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The
assessment shall be prepared by a suitably qualified heritage professional and
shall:<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">a) identify and assess the significance of all designated
and non-designated heritage assets that may be affected by the development,
including any Scheduled Monument and its setting;<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">b) assess the likely impact of the proposed works upon the
significance of those heritage assets; and<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">c) identify any measures required to avoid, minimise or
mitigate harm to heritage significance.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">The development shall thereafter be carried out in
accordance with the approved details.<o:p></o:p></p><p>









</p><p class="MsoNormal">Reason: To ensure the significance of heritage assets is
properly understood and conserved, and to safeguard the historic environment in
accordance with London Plan Policy HC1 and the policy D12.5 of the Merton Local
Plan.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal">No development, including any ground disturbance,
excavation, demolition or site clearance works, shall commence until:<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">b) a Written Scheme of Investigation (WSI) for
archaeological monitoring, prepared by a suitably qualified archaeological
contractor, has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning
Authority.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">The WSI shall include details of archaeological monitoring,
recording, reporting, archiving and publication. The approved scheme shall be
implemented in full and the development carried out in accordance with the
approved details.<o:p></o:p></p><p>





</p><p class="MsoNormal">Reason: To ensure that archaeological remains and the
significance of the Scheduled Monument are appropriately protected,
investigated and recorded in accordance with London Plan Policy HC1 and the policy
D12.5 of the Merton Local Plan.<o:p></o:p></p>
